parsed.explanation: No trans-specific offence, no facility ban, and no border evidence of trouble; neither is custody or entry screening documented. The dominant traveller-relevant exposure is police: a 2025 national human-rights submission documents harassment of transgender people at identity checks and arbitrary arrests on vagrancy/public-order grounds, plus 2020 reports of violent detentions — a state-tolerated lever against visibly gender-nonconforming people, and identity checks are exactly the encounter a visitor passes through. No anti-discrimination ground covers gender identity and no domestic remedy is documented, and LGBTIQ groups cannot register openly. Positives are climate signals only: asylum procedure names gender identity, a trans claimant prevailed (2022), and a public Pride was held. Dated incidents (2016, 2018, 2020) and no violence rate; but this matches the documented police-stops pattern rather than an organised campaign or universal exclusion. Sits above 0.25 (no custody-abuse pattern documented) and below 0.45 (no universal exposure rule).
